Title: Graduate Intern, Data Scientist (Spring 2027)
Company: Delta Air Lines
Details: Atlanta, GA | Onsite | Internship | Intern | salary n/a

Delta Air Lines connects the world by flying customers to destinations worldwide, and its Ops Digital Decision Science team provides decision support across major operational divisions using advanced analytics, including AI and machine learning. The Graduate Intern, Data Scientist will develop machine learning models, conduct data analysis, present insights, and create solutions to improve airline performance and decision-making.

Responsibilities:
- Work within a team of data scientists to develop advanced analytics solutions for complex business problems
- Collect data via SQL queries and perform exploratory data analysis
- Present analysis to business owners using concise but compelling narrative and visuals
- Learn new techniques within cloud-based platforms

Required:
- Pursuing a Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, or Computer Science
- Experience working with relational databases (SQL)
- Understanding of machine learning techniques (Python, SciKit Learn, or other machine learning platforms)
- Good written, oral communication, and interpersonal skills
- Must be able to commit to the duration of the internship timeline: January 11, 2027 – May 7, 2027
- Must be able to work onsite in the Atlanta, GA office
- Embraces diverse people, thinking and styles
- Consistently makes safety and security, of self and others, the priority
- Is at least 18 years of age and has authorization to work in the United States

Keywords: SQL, Relational Databases, Machine Learning, Python, Scikit-learn, Statistical Analysis, Data Storytelling, Exploratory Data Analysis, Master's Degree, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Computer Science, SciKit-Learn, Machine Learning Platforms, Internship Commitment, Atlanta Office
